notes.title: Good Lord! VN Patch 1.51 - Spanish Language Version typo and bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Various typos and misaligned text fixed in the Spanish Language Version
[*] Fixed missing translation of "Volleyball Player" name labels
[*] Fixed misalignment of Ending Credits.
[*] Corrected an issue that caused the Language Select screen to appear every time the game boots
[/list]

Players should be able to continue their previous save files without issue. You can also change languages from either the main menu or the options menu in game whenever you would like. Thank you again for playing!
